title: Life Admin & Services
description: Master the practical English needed for everyday administration: opening a bank account, visiting the doctor, contacting customer service, and dealing with official forms. Essential for A2 learners living or studying in an English-speaking environment.

content.text: I'd like to make an appointment to see a doctor, please. I have a sore throat and I've had a temperature since yesterday.

phrases.text: I'd like to make an appointment.
phrases.translation: Я хотел(а) бы записаться на приём.

phrases.text: How long have you had this?
Take one tablet twice a day.
phrases.translation: Принимайте по одной таблетке два раза в день.

questions.text: Which sentence correctly describes a symptom?
The doctor says 'Take two tablets three times a day.' How many tablets do you take in total per day?

content.content: {"time":1700030003000,"blocks":[{"id":"csA1bB2cC3d","type":"paragraph","data":{"text":"Dealing with customer service — whether by phone, online, or in person — requires specific vocabulary and a polite but assertive tone."}},{"id":"csD4eE5fF6g","type":"header","data":{"text":"Making a Complaint Politely","level":3}},{"id":"csG7hH8iI9j","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["I'm calling / writing about a problem with...","I ordered X but received Y.","I'm afraid this isn't what I expected.","Could you look into this for me?","I'd like a refund / replacement / explanation."]}},{"id":"csJ0kK1lL2m","type":"header","data":{"text":"Useful Phrases on the Phone","level":3}},{"id":"csM3nN4oO5p","type":"list","data":{"style":"unordered","items":["Could you put me through to the manager?","Can I leave a message?","Could you speak more slowly, please?","I'm sorry, I didn't catch that.","Let me give you my reference number."]}}],"version":"2.31.4"}

content.text: Hello, I'm calling about an order I placed last week. I'm afraid I received the wrong item. Could you help me arrange a return and refund please?

questions.text: Which phrase politely asks for help from customer service?
options: Give me my money back now!
Could you look into this for me?

questions.text: You didn't understand something on the phone. What do you say?
options: I'm sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you repeat that?
